en: Cittasampayuttaduka (The Pair on States Conjoined with Consciousness)
Dependent on a state not associated with consciousness, a state not associated with consciousness arises by way of root condition:
dependent on consciousness, mind-produced matter arises. Dependent on a state not associated with consciousness, a state dissociated from consciousness arises by way of root condition:
dependent on consciousness, the aggregates associated with consciousness arise.
(Regarding the mere set of negative pairs, one should not state that they fulfill the dhamma; thus, nine new questions are to be formulated for each:
Nine for root, three for object, five for predominance …pe… six for mutuality …pe… one for prenascence and repetition …pe… nine for non-disappearance.
